newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy big firm employment -3.5 pct yr/yr in April.
newsitem.headline: Italy big firm employment -3.5 pct yr/yr in April.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 3.5 percent year-on-year in April, the national statistics institiute Istat said.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 96.6 (1995=100) in April, with month-on-month employment up 0.1 percent from March.
Hours worked per employee rose 6.5 percent compared to April 1996, helped by one working day more in April 1997.
In the first four months of 1997, employment fell 3.7 percent compared to the same period in 1996, Istat said.
Istat said all sectors except the "other manufacturing industries" category were affected in April by the fall in employment. -- Rome newsroom +39 6 678 2501
